_comment: Single source of truth for competitor plan pricing shown on comparison pages and in articles. Everything is CAD per month. Where a vendor publishes in USD the entry carries converted_from, exchange_rate and rate_checked, plus usd_ fields holding the vendor's own figures; the CAD number is those converted and rounded. Re-derive the CAD values if the rate moves materially. Update a price and every page referencing it via competitor_price() or {placeholder} updates on the next page load. Entries with "category": "payroll" are payroll providers rather than accounting tools: they carry a per_employee fee alongside the monthly base, and /payroll/ multiplies the two out by headcount. Their prices are not published as cleanly as the accounting vendors', so each one carries a VERIFY note naming the page to check. Currency: all four payroll vendors are Canada-only products selling Canadian payroll, so their published figures are CAD. None of the four pages says so explicitly, which is worth knowing before anyone re-checks and worries. Treating them as CAD is also the conservative reading: if any turned out to be USD we would be understating a competitor, not overstating one.

honeybook.name: HoneyBook
honeybook._note: VERIFY: converted from USD list prices (Starter $29 / Essentials $49 / Premium $109, billed-yearly rate) at ~1.37 USD->CAD. No free plan (7-day trial).

sage.name: Sage
sage._note: VERIFY: Sage 50 (desktop app), billed annually; monthly = annual/12 rounded. Pro $814/yr (1 user), Premium $1,219/yr (2 users), Quantum $5,636/yr (5 users). No free plan (trial).

zoho-books.name: Zoho Books
zoho-books._note: Zoho Books official Canadian pricing (billed-annually rate): Free $0 / Standard $15 / Professional $30 / Premium $40 / Elite $165 / Ultimate $290 CAD. Cloud-only. Free plan is capped to micro-businesses (low annual-revenue limit, 1 user).

invoice2go.name: Invoice2Go
invoice2go._note: Prices converted from USD at 2026-08-01 (1 USD = 1.40315 CAD, checked 2026-08-01) and rounded to the nearest dollar, so a Canadian reader compares like for like. The vendor publishes in USD; keep the usd_ fields as the source of truth and re-derive if the rate moves materially. USD: invoice.2go.com prices in USD, not CAD. Starter and Professional cap invoices, so Premium is the only like-for-like tier.

square-invoices.name: Square Invoices
square-invoices._note: squarepay.ca prices in CAD. Free tier has unlimited invoicing, so this comparison is not about price.

manager.name: Manager.io
manager._note: Prices converted from USD at 2026-08-01 (1 USD = 1.40315 CAD, checked 2026-08-01) and rounded to the nearest dollar, so a Canadian reader compares like for like. The vendor publishes in USD; keep the usd_ fields as the source of truth and re-derive if the rate moves materially. USD. Desktop edition is free; only the cloud edition is paid.

bonsai.name: Bonsai
bonsai._note: Prices converted from USD at 2026-08-01 (1 USD = 1.40315 CAD, checked 2026-08-01) and rounded to the nearest dollar, so a Canadian reader compares like for like. The vendor publishes in USD; keep the usd_ fields as the source of truth and re-derive if the rate moves materially. USD assumed: no currency selector on the pricing page. Per user. Invoicing starts at Essentials, so Basic is not comparable.

wagepoint.name: Wagepoint
wagepoint._note: Checked against wagepoint.com/pricing on 2026-09-07. CAD: Wagepoint serves Canada only, in their own words, so there is no other currency it could be. Cloud only, priced as a monthly base fee plus a per-employee fee. Solo is capped at one pay run a month.

quickbooks-payroll.name: QuickBooks Payroll
quickbooks-payroll._note: Checked against quickbooks.intuit.com/ca/payroll/ on 2026-09-07. Canadian edition. Sold as a bundle with QuickBooks Online rather than as a separate add-on, so these are the whole monthly cost of the books and payroll together, which is what Argo Books Premium is compared against. Regular prices, NOT the promotional rate: the page advertises 90% off for six months, and a six-month discount is not what a comparison should quote. Standalone payroll without QuickBooks Online also exists and is not covered here.

payworks.name: Payworks
payworks._note: VERIFY against payworks.ca before relying on these. Canadian workforce-management provider aimed at small and mid-sized employers; quotes are usually given per client rather than published, so treat the base fee as approximate. Figures from a 2026 third-party review.

knit.name: Knit
knit._note: Checked against knitpeople.com/pricing on 2026-09-07. Canadian payroll and HR provider.

gnucash.name: GnuCash
gnucash._note: Free and open source (GPL), desktop, data stored locally. No paid tier exists, so there is no price to keep current.

spreadsheet.name: Spreadsheets
spreadsheet._note: Not a product. Represents Excel, Google Sheets or LibreOffice used as bookkeeping. No licence price quoted: most people already own one, and the real cost is time, not the spreadsheet.
